Team —

I'm proposing a 3-week 'Invite Blitz' cadence for the Sept 14 Architect webinar (90-min technical session + Q&A) to help us hit target seats for the CloudBridge co-host. High level: rapid seeding (week 1), reminder + social proof (week 2), countdown + last-chance (week 3).

Ask: please review the attached tracking sheet and confirm these three things by EOD Mon (30 Aug):
- final audience segments (seed / warm / cold) and send windows per segment
- UTM parameter naming (I started a tab in the sheet)
- RSVP reminder times (I suggest 48h, 24h, 2h)

Attachments: invite-blitz-tracking-sheet.xlsx (tracking + audience tabs)

Notes: we need HubSpot campaign id so CS can see attendees per AE; also CloudBridge requires co-host promo copy two days before send.

Thanks —
